deploy.startCommand: set -e; echo NEXORA_GATE09_CONFIG_REFRESH=20260905; OWNER_DATABASE_URL="$NEXORA_MIGRATOR_DATABASE_URL"; if [[ "$OWNER_DATABASE_URL" == *"?"* ]]; then OWNER_DATABASE_URL="${OWNER_DATABASE_URL}&options=-c%20role%3Dnexora_owner"; else OWNER_DATABASE_URL="${OWNER_DATABASE_URL}?options=-c%20role%3Dnexora_owner"; fi; echo NEXORA_MIGRATION_ROLE_CHAIN_START; DATABASE_URL="$OWNER_DATABASE_URL" node --input-type=module -e "import postgres from 'postgres'; const sql=postgres(process.env.DATABASE_URL); try { const r=await sql`select session_user || ':' || current_user as role_chain`; console.log('NEXORA_MIGRATION_ROLE_CHAIN='+r[0].role_chain); } finally { await sql.end(); }"; echo NEXORA_MIGRATION_GATE_START; DATABASE_URL="$OWNER_DATABASE_URL" pnpm --filter @nexora/database db:migrate; rc=$?; echo NEXORA_MIGRATION_GATE_RC=$rc; test $rc -eq 0 || exit $rc; pnpm --filter @nexora/api start
